summary: Amends title 23 of the U.S. Code to add connecting existing bike/pedestrian infrastructure segments and reducing risks to vulnerable road users as eligible highway safety improvement projects, while allowing up to 100% federal funding share and flexible nonfederal match rules for those projects and proven safety countermeasures.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends the highway safety improvement program (23 U.S.C. 148) to add new eligible project types for bicyclist/pedestrian infrastructure and vulnerable road user safety. It explicitly raises the maximum federal share to 100% for these projects (amending sections 148(j), 133(h)(7), and 120(c)(1)), reducing or eliminating state/local matching requirements. This directly facilitates greater federal outlays on transportation safety without new revenue offsets, constituting an expansion of government spending.
